# Urmzd

> Urmzd's GitHub profile README repository. The page lists the projects with the most recent work, the latest releases, and every other public project. A script regenerates it nightly from public GitHub data, ranked by commit activity. No model is involved.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/urmzd/urmzd/blob/main/README.md): The generated profile page

## API / Key Files

- [scripts/generate_readme.py](https://github.com/urmzd/urmzd/blob/main/scripts/generate_readme.py): The generator, Python standard library only
- [profile.toml](https://github.com/urmzd/urmzd/blob/main/profile.toml): Name, bio, links and exclusions
- [.github/workflows/publish.yml](https://github.com/urmzd/urmzd/blob/main/.github/workflows/publish.yml): The nightly run
